summary: LAUNCH-READINESS test iteration 12. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests in test_launch_readiness.py all pass covering: (a) fresh registration -> token + empty profiles + /api/recipes 402 without membership + /api/recipes/samples public; (b) admin+demo login 200, wrong password 401; (c) forgot-password returns exact {ok:true} with no token in body, DB gets reset_token; reset-password to 'NewAdmin2026!' succeeds, login with new pw works, then restored to '<admin password redacted>'; (d) Stripe checkout POST /api/payments/checkout with lookup_key=monthly returns checkout_url containing stripe.com + session_id; GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns pending; (e) admin revoke of demo family -> has_active_membership=false, /api/recipes returns 402; admin generates annual code (batch_id present), fresh family redeems -> membership_expires_at ~+365 days, /api/recipes 200, second redeem 400, invalid code 404; demo restored via admin-generated annual code; (f) all 4 tiers (little/junior/teen/adult) return array; (g) recipe card: PDF uploaded via /api/files/upload (purpose=recipe_card, returns {file_id,url}), PATCH /api/recipes/{id} with recipe_card_file_id, demo downloads via /api/recipes/{id}/card 200 with application/pdf, recipes without card return 404, then detached for cleanup; (h) admin editing endpoints all work: recipe PATCH title, duplicate creates '(Copy)' recipe, flags PUT with {flags:{personalized_pdf_export:new}} persists to GET /flags then restored, Etsy URL save+clear, codes print-sheet.pdf 200, CSV exports for families/recipes/codes 200, printable PATCH 200; (i) journal entry persists across sessions (create+login with new token+read), demo has >=4 profiles; (j) JWT security: bad token 401, no token 401. Frontend: demo login redirects to /app, dashboard renders, /app/library shows seasonal-collections; all 4 /app/book/{tier} pages load with proper h1 headings (Little Chefs/Junior Cooks/Teen Kitchen/Mom & Dad — Quick & Easy); corrupt JWT in localStorage -> reload /app -> redirected to /auth (Protected works); mobile viewport 390x844 has NO horizontal overflow on /, /auth, /redeem, /gift, /faq, /terms, /privacy. Admin UI panel verification was partially blocked mid-run by login rate limit (5/300s IP+email hit by earlier browser retries); backend admin endpoints all confirmed via pytest, and admin panel testids (admin-tab-*, admin-recipe-edit-*, admin-recipe-dup-*, admin-recipe-feature-*, featured-starts/ends, weekly-drop-broadcast) exist in /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (verified via grep) and were fully exercised successfully in prior iterations 10-11. Test-data cleanup: Etsy URL restored to '', flags restored to original, featured_recipe cleared, admin password restored to <admin password redacted>, uploaded recipe card detached, generated redemption code consumed by fresh family (unredeemed codes not left dangling in bulk).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1158 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, recipes.py, admin.py, payments.py, printables.py) for maintainability. Not launch-blocking.

POST /api/files/upload response shape is {file_id, url} while several other create endpoints (POST /api/recipes, POST /api/admin/codes, POST /api/journal) return {id, ...}. Consider aligning on a single naming convention for the primary key across responses; minor DX polish.

GET /api/recipes/featured returns fallback=true both when featured recipe is not scheduled AND when user has no membership (fallback recipe filtered out) - the flag is overloaded. A 'reason' field would clarify. Called out in iteration 11 as well; still present.

/api/admin/families/{uid}/revoke uses POST (not DELETE/PATCH) and sets membership_expires_at=null; no equivalent restore endpoint - restore requires admin generating a code and family redeeming, or manual DB edit. Consider adding PATCH /api/admin/families/{uid} to set membership_expires_at directly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verified paths (login, dashboard, library, 4 books, protected route, mobile no-overflow on 7 public pages)
